description: Defines a template class BinderProxy that manages a cached proxy for an Android service, handling service connection and death notifications.

classes.name: BinderProxy
classes.description: A utility class that caches a service proxy and manages death notifications, ensuring the service is available and handling its death.

classes.name: BinderProxy::DeathRecipient
classes.description: Inner class that implements IBinder::DeathRecipient to handle binder death events.

methods.name: waitServiceOrDie
methods.description: Waits for the service to become available, or terminates if the service does not implement the required interface.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles the death of the binder, clearing the cached delegate and logging a warning.
